meta.pageTitle: GATE General Aptitude PYQ (with Answers & Solutions)

questions.text: A court is to a judge as _________ is to a teacher.
questions.solution:
A judge works in a court; a teacher works in a school (workplace relation).

Answer: a school

questions.text: Ten friends planned to share equally the cost of buying a gift for their teacher. When two of them decided not to contribute, each of the other friends had to pay Rs. 150 more. The cost of the gift was Rs. ___
questions.solution:
Let the cost be x. Planned share = x/10; actual share = x/8.

[latex]\frac x8-\frac x{10}=150\Rightarrow\frac{x}{40}=150\Rightarrow x=6000[/latex]

Answer: 6000

questions.text: Two cars at the same time from the same location and go in the same direction. The speed of the first car is 50 km/h and the speed of the second car is 60 km/h. The number of hours it takes for the distance between the two cars to be 20 km is _____.
questions.solution:
Both start together in the same direction, so the gap grows at the relative speed 60 [latex]-[/latex] 50 = 10 km/h.

Time for a 20 km gap = 20 / 10 = 2 hours.

Answer: 2

questions.text: The search engine's business model ____ around the fulcrum of trust.
questions.solution:
A fulcrum is a pivot point; something revolves around a pivot. The business model revolves around trust.

Answer: revolves

questions.text: The expenditure on the project __________ as follows: equipment Rs.20 lakhs, salaries Rs.12 lakhs, and contingency Rs.3 lakhs.
questions.solution:
The subject "the expenditure" is singular, so the verb must be singular: breaks down (meaning "is divided into" the listed parts).

Answer: breaks down
